current_board_source.y1: Governed 335-player raw 2026 Y1 fantasy-point board, existing durable artifact only.
current_board_source.identity_history: Approved 335-row replacement identity/history coordinate, existing durable artifact only.

materialization.experience: 2026 NFL experience from approved identity/history coordinate; career buckets 0-3,4-8,9+.
materialization.source_points: Governed raw Y1 fantasy-point projection on the same scoring coordinate.
materialization.source_state: Apply PIT state boundaries fitted from completed historical fantasy points through 2025, using the frozen 1-D log-space state-boundary algorithm.
materialization.source_percentile: Average-rank percentile of Y1 source_points within current-board position; (rank-0.5)/n.
materialization.state_percentile: Average-rank percentile of Y1 source_points within current-board position x source_state; used only by the shared D ordered-state layer.
materialization.prior1_points: 2025 completed-season fantasy points from approved history when mapped; otherwise uncovered.
materialization.prior1_coverage: 1 only with genuine 2025 player history; else 0.
materialization.source_role_band: Most recent completed 2025 governed role band when mapped; otherwise unknown.
materialization.games: 2025 completed-season games when mapped; otherwise missing.
materialization.opportunity_per_game: 2025 completed-season governed opportunity_per_game when mapped; otherwise missing.
materialization.prior_age_state_resid_z: 2025 PIT position x coarse-age-band x state residual for QB C-memory, computed using seasons strictly before 2025; missing/unsupported -> 0 plus coverage=0.
materialization.prior2_consistency: D1 uses the genuine 2025 and 2024 PIT age-band x state residuals; coverage=1 only if both exist. No history backfill or projection substitution.
materialization.cold_start: Projection-only or unmatched players keep all prior-history coverage flags at 0. Y1 projection is never treated as an observed NFL prior season.
